rationale: S-0007-01 proposes a dedicated sanity simulation to validate the custom khhchan.mod biophysics. The from-scratch wave (t0052/t0053/t0054/t0055/t0057) uses standard NEURON `hh` channel mechanism on soma and AIS; khhchan.mod is no longer on the active substrate's channel path. The validation may matter again if the deposited-DSGC line is revived or active dendritic conductances (RQ4) require a custom HH variant, but it is not gating any current research line. Reprioritising from high to medium.
